resources.string: We have made some changes since you last logged in. Here are the details:

Version %1$s:
  • Improved timeline video playback with smoother transitions, better automatic video selection, and playback progress preserved when opening or closing the media viewer.
  • Improved timeline reliability: replies and conversation context remain visible during refreshes, the new-posts banner updates correctly, and paging crashes are fixed.
  • Improved accessibility across posts, media, and the compose screen with clearer labels, states, and controls.
  • Improved Bluesky session reliability, compatibility with new X timeline responses, and support for more Pixiv artwork and profile link formats.
